(By Shri Y. D. Yadav, Govt. Advocate &

 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

1. This is first bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant who is in custody since 21.2.2023 in connection with Crime No.48/2023 registered at Police Station Jawar, District Khandwa (M.P.), for the offence punishable under sections 363, 366(A) and 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 5(L) and 6 of POCSO Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is a young man aged about 18 years and prosecutrix is aged about 16 years and 2 months.
As per prosecution story, applicant has given lift to prosecutrix to drop her at school.

Later on applicant took her to Khandwa and said to have Shivam vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/183406806/
1 committed rape on her.

sentences.text: It is submitted that prosecutrix did not resist or made any hue and cry while going to Khandwa.
No external or internal injury was found in pre- MLC.
It is submitted that prosecutrix was a consenting party.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State as well as learned counsel for the objector opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
It is submitted that prosecutrix was minor and offence is serious in nature.
Prosecutrix tried to commit suicide by jumping into the well.
Later on she was saved by other people.
In these circumstances, bail application be dismissed.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5.
Prosecutrix has jumped into the well as she was afraid that her father will ask her about her absent from school and will also beat her.
From prosecution story it appears that prosecutrix was a consenting party.
She is aged more than 16 years with sufficient maturity.
6. Considering the aforesaid circumstances, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.

8. The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated under Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
C.C as per rules.
